model.summary: Model favors SEA by 7.8 points (76% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (SEA +4.0), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (SEA +1.5), Defense EPA allowed/play (season blend) (SEA +1.5). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 42.5 total points (SEA 25, ARI 17). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.9), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.0), Divisional game (lowers total 0.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
